Description:
  Use convention to derive a SemVer product version from a GitFlow or GitHub based repository.

Usage:
  dotnet-gitversion [<path>] [command] [options]

Arguments:
  <path>  The directory containing .git. If not defined current directory is used. (Must be first argument)

Options:
  -d, --diagnose                                   Runs GitVersion with additional diagnostic information.
                                                   Also needs the '--log-file' argument to specify a logfile or stdout (requires git.exe to be installed)
  -l, --log-file <log-file>                        Path to logfile; specify 'console' to emit to stderr
  -o, --output <output>                            Determines the output to the console. Can be either 'json', 'file', 'buildserver' or 'dotenv', will default to 'json'
  --output-file <output-file>                      Path to output file. It is used in combination with --output 'file'
  -v, --show-variable <show-variable>              Used in conjunction with --output json, will output just a particular variable.
                                                   E.g. --output json --show-variable SemVer - will output `1.2.3+beta.4`
  -f, --format <format>                            Used in conjunction with --output json, will output a format containing version variables.
                                                   Supports C# format strings - see [Format Strings](/docs/reference/custom-formatting) for details.
                                                   E.g. --output json --format {SemVer} - will output `1.2.3+beta.4`

Description:
  Manages GitVersion configuration.

Usage:
  dotnet-gitversion [<path>] config [command] [options]

Arguments:
  <path>  The directory containing .git. If not defined current directory is used. (Must be first argument)

Options:
  -?, -h, --help       Show help and usage information
  --cli-schema         Writes the complete OpenCLI 0.1 command schema as JSON and exits.
  --telemetry-opt-out  Disables optional sampled usage telemetry.

Commands:
  migrate              Migrates a v6 configuration document to the v7 structure.
  get <property-path>  Queries a scalar property of the effective v7 configuration as JSON.
  validate             Validates a configuration file without calculating a version or accessing a Git backend.

Description:
  Migrates a v6 configuration document to the v7 structure.

Usage:
  dotnet-gitversion [<path>] config migrate [options]

Arguments:
  <path>  The directory containing .git. If not defined current directory is used. (Must be first argument)

Options:
  -c, --config <config>  Path to the configuration file to migrate.
  --output <output>      Path to write the migrated configuration document.
  --in-place             Replace the input configuration file.
  --force                Allow --output to replace an existing file.
  -?, -h, --help         Show help and usage information
  --cli-schema           Writes the complete OpenCLI 0.1 command schema as JSON and exits.
  --telemetry-opt-out    Disables optional sampled usage telemetry.

Description:
  Queries a scalar property of the effective v7 configuration as JSON.

Usage:
  dotnet-gitversion [<path>] config get <property-path> [options]

Arguments:
  <path>           The directory containing .git. If not defined current directory is used. (Must be first argument)
  <property-path>  Dot-separated public v7 property path, e.g. calculation.tag-prefix. Maps and collections are not supported.

Options:
  -c, --config <config>                Path to config file (defaults to GitVersion.yml, GitVersion.yaml, .GitVersion.yml or .GitVersion.yaml)
  --override-config <override-config>  Overrides GitVersion config values inline (key=value pairs e.g. --override-config workflow=GitHubFlow/v1)
  --target-path <target-path>          Same as 'path', but not positional
  -l, --log-file <log-file>            Path to logfile; specify 'console' to emit to stderr
  --verbosity <verbosity>              Specifies the amount of information to be displayed (Quiet, Minimal, Normal, Verbose, Diagnostic). Default is Normal
  -?, -h, --help                       Show help and usage information
  --cli-schema                         Writes the complete OpenCLI 0.1 command schema as JSON and exits.
  --telemetry-opt-out                  Disables optional sampled usage telemetry.

  --target-path <target-path>          Same as 'path', but not positional
  --format <format>                    Emit one versioned JSON validation result (json). Default: diagnostics on stderr and empty stdout.

  --telemetry-opt-out                  Disables optional sampled usage telemetry.
